title: [SOA] Use company display name in default email signature
summary: Sales Order Agent now uses company display name instead of internal company identifier in default email signatures, improving customer communication.
key_points: Replace CompanyName() with CompanyProperty.DisplayName() in email signatures
Applies to default setup signature, agent instructions, and outgoing-message fallback
Preserves existing HTML formatting, AI disclosure, and custom-signature behavior
Affects signatures when display name differs from internal company identifier
Low-risk single-line change with no schema or permission modifications
